pr_title: Fix check for duplicate config entry reauth when context is passed or augmented
pr_body:
## Proposed change
<!--
  Describe the big picture of your changes here to communicate to the
  maintainers why we should accept this pull request. If it fixes a bug
  or resolves a feature request, be sure to link to that issue in the
  additional information section.
-->
If the context was not the same we could end up creating multiple reauth flows for the same config entry.

fixes #77578 as esphome would call `await self.fetch_device_info()` which adds additional info to `self.context` which would make the check fail to match and thus allow another reauth flow

issue_context.title: Duplicate "Attention required" notifications for ESPHome
issue_context.body: ### The problem Home Assistant creates many duplicate "Attention required" notifications when something goes wrong with an ESPHome integration. I believe it creates one every 10 minutes. ### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue? 2022.8.6 ### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core? _No response_ ### What type of installation are you running? Home Assistant Supervised ### Integration causing the issue ESPHome ### Link to integration documentation on our website https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/esphome/ ### Diagnostics information _No response_ ### Example YAML snippet _No response_ ### Anything in the logs that might be useful for us? _No response_ ### Additional information _No response_
comments:
Hey there @ottowinter, @jesserockz, mind taking a look at this issue as it has been labeled with an integration (`esphome`) you are listed as a [code owner](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/dev/CODEOWNERS#L318) for? Thanks!
<sub><sup>(message by CodeOwnersMention)</sup></sub>

I have this issue as well and now need to find a solution to get rid of 100s of notifications :thinking: .
Any suggestions?
Same here. When I try to reconfigure the device, it says the encryption key is not valid. And I don't know how to remove all those duplicate devices.
Ok so I had updated Home Assistant OS but not Home Assistant Core, which seems to have fixed the issue.

@kamaradclimber 
> I have this issue as well and now need to find a solution to get rid of 100s of notifications 🤔 . Any suggestions?

Restarting Home Assistant via dev tools cleared them for me (the integrations page via the app was unresponsive due to the notifications).

Attempting to use the 'Reconfigure' button and providing the encryption key resulted in a 'device already exists' error. I deleted the device and re-added it via +Add Integration. Attempting to 'Reconfigure' instead of re-adding resulted in a json error. I know this isn't ideal, but it's what fixed it for me. My HA Core appeared to already be updated.

I am also having this issue, but only for 1 specific device, what is very strange however is that to try and resolve i deleted, reflashed without an enc key and the same problem keeps occurring, it was fine for a few days but I had to restart ha due to some dashboard changes and its started again. in the list in ESP home this device affected is the first one int he list so that may well be why its the one affected.

I have the same issue. Now have thousands of duplicates
Home assistant 22.10.05
Operating system 9.2
Esphome 22.10.0

Very annoying. Same issue, and dev tool restart did clear a few hundreds, but some remain. 
HA 22.10.5
OS 9.2
ESPHome 22.10.2
